newsitem.title: CHINA: China service sector output seen at $132 bln in 97.
newsitem.headline: China service sector output seen at $132 bln in 97.

text.p: China's service sector output is estimated at 1096.1 billion yuan ($132.06 billion) in 1997, up 9.0 percent from last year, the China Business Daily said on Tuesday.
The newspaper gave no further details.

China has said its service sector accounted for 38.1 percent of gross domestic product (GDP) in the first quarter of this year, and the period was the first time for several years that the sector's proportion of GDP had increased.
